Class WasmEngine

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.wasm.WasmEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public abstract class WasmEngine extends Object implements Closeable
Abstraction over the WebAssembly runtime used to execute the compiled codec modules (c2pa, ultrahdr, …).

Two implementations exist:

  • ChicoryEngine — pure-JVM interpreter, zero native dependencies, works on any JVM (default).
  • GraalWasmEngine — GraalVM's Truffle-based WebAssembly runtime; only usable when the GraalVM polyglot artifacts are on the classpath and faster on GraalVM (JIT) than on a stock JVM.

The engine is chosen automatically by create(String, byte[]) (see there for the selection rules) and can be pinned with the wasm.engine system property (auto, chicory, or graalvm).

Module memory contract: every module executed through this engine must export wasm_alloc(size) -> ptr and wasm_free(ptr, size) — the standard ownership convention used by all fliiifenleger codec crates (see the crate READMEs). WasmMemory and friends build on these exports.

Threading: WASM instances are neither thread-safe nor allowed to hop host threads — every instance is bound to the single worker thread that created it (see WasmLanePool). Separate instances are fully isolated and may run concurrently; a single instance must never be shared across threads.

    • LANES_PROPERTY

      public static final String LANES_PROPERTY
      System property for the global lane-parallelism fallback used when a caller does not request an explicit count. Unset (or blank) means one lane per available processor (Chicory; GraalWasm stays capped, see resolveParallelism(int, String)). Set 1 for serial execution.

  • Method Details

    • create

      public static WasmEngine create(String selection, byte[] wasmBytes) throws IOException
      Create an engine for the given WASM module bytes, honouring the wasm.engine system property.

      Selection rules:

      • chicory — always use Chicory (default for a pinned selection).
      • graalvm — use GraalWasm; requires the GraalVM polyglot artifacts on the classpath.
      • auto (default) — on a GraalVM runtime, prefer GraalWasm when its artifacts are present; otherwise use Chicory. If the preferred engine fails to load the module, fall back to Chicory (which works on every JVM).
      Parameters:
      selection - One of auto, chicory, graalvm, or null for auto.
      wasmBytes - Raw WASM module bytes.
      Returns:
      A ready-to-use engine with the module loaded.
      Throws:
      IOException - if no engine could load the module.

    • resolveParallelism

      public static int resolveParallelism(int requested, String selection)
      Resolves the effective lane count for parallel WASM execution.
      Parameters:
      requested - Requested lanes; must be at least 1.
      selection - Engine selection as in create(String, byte[]) (may be null).
      Returns:
      requested clamped to the available processors (and to MAX_GRAAL_LANES for GraalWasm).
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if requested < 1.

    • systemParallelism

      public static int systemParallelism(String selection)
      Resolves lane parallelism from the LANES_PROPERTY system property, defaulting to one lane per available processor capped at DEFAULT_MAX_LANES when unset or blank. Explicit 1 selects serial execution.
      Parameters:
      selection - Engine selection as in create(String, byte[]) (may be null).
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the property value is not a positive integer.
